description: This file defines the class Zend_Http_UserAgent_Mobile, which extends Zend_Http_UserAgent_AbstractDevice. It provides functionality for detecting mobile user agents, matching user agent signatures, and retrieving device features related to mobile browsers within the Zend Framework HTTP package.

classes.name: Zend_Http_UserAgent_Mobile
classes.description: A class for detecting and handling mobile user agents, extending the abstract device class, with features such as user agent matching, device feature detection, and support queries.

methods.name: match
methods.description: Static method to determine if a given user agent or server array matches a mobile device signature.

methods.name: userAgentStart
methods.description: Static method to check if the first four characters of the user agent match known mobile prefixes.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor initializes the mobile user agent with optional user agent string, server environment, and configuration. Sets default features adapter if not provided.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Returns the string 'mobile' indicating the device type.

methods.name: _defineFeatures
methods.description: Protected method to set device features based on detected user agent and configuration.

methods.name: getMarkupLanguage
methods.description: Determines the expected markup language (e.g., WML, HTML, XHTML) based on preferred markup.

methods.name: getImageFormatSupport
methods.description: Returns supported image formats for the device.

methods.name: getMaxImageHeight
methods.description: Returns the maximum supported image height.

methods.name: getMaxImageWidth
methods.description: Returns the maximum supported image width.

methods.name: getPhysicalScreenHeight
methods.description: Returns the physical screen height in pixels.

methods.name: getPhysicalScreenWidth
methods.description: Returns the physical screen width in pixels.

methods.name: getPreferredMarkup
methods.description: Returns the preferred markup language for the device.

methods.name: getXhtmlSupportLevel
methods.description: Returns the level of XHTML support.

methods.name: hasFlashSupport
methods.description: Checks if the device supports Flash.

methods.name: hasPdfSupport
methods.description: Checks if the device supports PDF.

methods.name: hasPhoneNumber
methods.description: Checks if the device has an associated phone number.

methods.name: httpsSupport
methods.description: Checks if the device supports HTTPS.
